UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$User = '{{MqttUsername}}'; $Password = '{{MqttPassword}}'; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; $Clean = { Get-ChildItem -Force -File -Filter 'passwords.txt.backup.*' | ForEach-Object { icacls $_.FullName /reset *> $null; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; & $Clean; if (-not $User) { exit 0 }; if (-not $Password) { Write-Output 'A password is required for the MQTT user. Skipping'; exit 0 }; & '.\mosquitto_passwd.exe' -b 'passwords.txt' $User $Password; $Code = $LASTEXITCODE; & $Clean; exit $Code"

-c "chmod 0700 '{{$FullBaseDir}}passwords.txt' 2>/dev/null; u='{{MqttUsername}}'; p='{{MqttPassword}}'; [ -z \"$u\" ] && exit 0; [ -z \"$p\" ] && { echo 'A password is required for the MQTT user. Skipping'; exit 0; }; mosquitto_passwd -b '{{$FullBaseDir}}passwords.txt' \"$u\" \"$p\""
